prompt.project_info: A grounded poolside summer portrait with wet hair, cedar decking, blue swimwear, and direct noon sun.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with wet slicked-back hair, natural freckles, and a relaxed closed-eye expression. She wears an unbranded medium-blue ribbed one-piece swimsuit with a modest scoop neckline and sits upright at the edge of a pool deck.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body poolside portrait from a respectful eye-level distance: weathered dark cedar deck, white horizontal siding, a timber post, terracotta planters, Mediterranean greenery, river pebbles, and pool water. No logos, text, or body-part emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct 5500K midday sunlight creates crisp deck shadows and small realistic water highlights. Preserve wet wood, droplets, freckles, natural skin texture, and a clean summer contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens at f/2.8, 9:16 vertical crop, RAW-style documentary photo, moderate background separation, realistic noise and highlight roll-off.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic poolside portrait of an adult woman with wet slicked-back hair and natural freckles, seated upright at the edge of a pool deck with eyes closed toward the sun. She wears an unbranded medium-blue ribbed one-piece swimsuit with a modest scoop neckline. Weathered dark cedar decking, white horizontal siding, timber post, terracotta planters, Mediterranean greenery, river pebbles, and pool water, direct high-noon sunlight with crisp shadows and realistic droplets, vertical 9:16 framing, natural skin texture, no logos or text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, distorted anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use an approved adult identity reference only if needed; do not use celebrity likeness. Preserve blue one-piece swimwear, seated pool-deck pose, wet hair, noon sun, and architectural setting. Identity, pool, and plants are replaceable through approved references.
